final: WITH filtered_data AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.bandusagepct, o.weathprofile FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1), profile_stats AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as num_telescopes FROM filtered_data GROUP BY weathprofile), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as mean_avg FROM profile_stats WHERE avg_bandwidth IS NOT NULL) SELECT ps.weathprofile, ps.avg_bandwidth, ps.num_telescopes, ps.avg_bandwidth - om.mean_avg as distance_from_mean FROM profile_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE om.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ps.weathprofile
